title: Rosettes of the tomb of Hafiz (Shiraz)
subtitle: Tomb of Hafiz, Shiraz

given.O: The centre of a sixteen-pointed star.

construction.note: The finished design was read from Wichmann’s FIG8 drawing: sixteen-pointed stars ringed by kites and pentagons, eight-pointed stars between them, octagons, and a four-pointed star at each corner of the square tile. Every edge runs at 11.25° plus a multiple of 22.5°. The star’s lines join points of its circle 90° apart and, carried on, make the kites round it. Each pentagon has three equal outer sides, and the eight-pointed star’s points fix the tile; every other line runs through a crossing of earlier lines. The drawing gives no steps; we devised the construction.
construction.changes: The compass steps, their order and the named points are ours. The tile is 0.005% smaller than Wichmann’s (0.008 pt in his drawing). Colours follow his drawing. No photograph was checked.

credits.source: Tiling Search, data169/FIG8: Tomb of Hafiz, Shiraz
credits.creator: Brian Wichmann
credits.note: Read from his finished drawing, not construction instructions. His references are a letter from Anthony Lee (the tomb of Hafiz at Shiraz) and a photograph of the Kok Gumbaz mosque at Shahrisabz.

steps.text: Draw a horizontal straight line through O and A. Draw a circle with centre O through A.

Draw a vertical line through O. It crosses the circle at S5. Draw the line through O that halves the angle between the horizontal and the vertical line. It crosses the circle at S3. Draw a line through O at 90° to it. Draw the line through O that halves the angle between the horizontal line and the line through S3. It crosses the circle at S2. Turn this line round O by 45°, three times. The lines through O cross the circle at S1 to S16, with S1 at A.
steps.textWithoutHelpers: Draw a vertical line through O. It crosses the circle at S5. Draw the line through O that halves the angle between the horizontal and the vertical line. It crosses the circle at S3. Draw a line through O at 90° to it. Draw the line through O that halves the angle between the horizontal line and the line through S3. It crosses the circle at S2.

steps.text: Draw the line through O that halves the angle between the horizontal line and the line through S2. It crosses the circle at U1. Turn this line round O by 22.5°, seven times. These lines cross the circle at U1 to U16, halfway between the earlier points.
steps.textWithoutHelpers: Draw the line through O that halves the angle between the horizontal line and the line through S2. It crosses the circle at U1. Draw a line through O at 90° to it. Mark the points U1 to U16 on the circle, 22.5° apart, starting from U1.

steps.text: Draw a straight line through U1 and U5. Turn it round O by 22.5°, fifteen times. These sixteen lines make the star at O.
The line through U1 and U5 crosses the horizontal line at E, beyond A. Draw a line through E parallel to the 67.5° line through O. Turn it round O by 22.5°, fifteen times.
steps.textWithoutHelpers: The line through U1 and U5 crosses the horizontal line at E, beyond A. Draw a line through E parallel to the 67.5° line through O.

steps.text: The line through U2 and U6 crosses the 67.5° line through E at F. Draw a line through F parallel to the 101.25° line through O. Turn it round O by 22.5°, fifteen times.

The line through U13 and U1 crosses the 67.5° line through E, turned by 90°, at G. Draw a line through G parallel to the 135° line through O. It crosses the line through U12 and U16 at H. Draw a vertical line through H. It crosses the horizontal line at M. Turn the vertical line round O by 90°, three times. The four lines make a square with corners K1, K2, K3 and K4.
steps.textWithoutHelpers: The line through U13 and U1 crosses the 101.25° line through F, turned by 22.5°, at G. Draw a line through G parallel to the 135° line through O. It crosses the line through U12 and U16 at H. Draw a vertical line through H. It crosses the horizontal line at M. Turn the vertical line round O by 90°, twice. These are three sides of a square with corners K1, K2, K3 and K4. Its fourth side is not drawn.

steps.text: Draw a line through H parallel to the 146.25° line through O. Turn it round O by 22.5°, fifteen times.
The 67.5° line through E crosses the vertical line through M at P1. Draw a line through P1 parallel to the 146.25° line through O. Turn it round O by 90°, three times.

The 45° line through O crosses the 146.25° line through P1 at P2. Draw a line through P2 parallel to the 123.75° line through O. Draw a line through P1 parallel to the 33.75° line through O. Turn the new lines round O by 90°, three times.
The horizontal line through O crosses the 33.75° line through P1 at P3. Draw a line through P3 parallel to the 146.25° line through O. Turn it round O by 90°, three times.
Join K1, K2, K3 and K4 to mark the tile that repeats.

ink.text: Ink the lines picked out in orange. They close the stars, the pentagons and the pieces between them.

pattern.text: Put copies of the square tile side by side. The sixteen-pointed stars sit at the tile’s centre and, between them, four-pointed stars at its corners.
